propositions: jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses config keys are inert (no code reads them) and must be hard-removed from the schema with operator approval
Both schema fields and their coercers must be deleted from _config_schema.py, and deprecated _scheduled rows replaced with warn-class tombstone entries in _deprecations.py

Removed keys must be tombstoned with warn severity (not error) because they are operationally inert, and their auto-derived env twins (REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES and REBAR_RECONCILER_RESOLVED_STATUSES) must also be tombstoned
Config still carrying the removed keys must load successfully and warn rather than raise; the keys must be dropped from the parsed output

All documentation references (docs/config.md, docs/user-guide.md, release-notes.md, CHANGELOG.md) must be removed and deprecation registry rows must be replaced with a historical note recording the 2026-08-12 operator-approved removal
All gates (ten check_* tests, generators, lint, typecheck, pytest, config-read heldout test) must pass with no orphaned # read-via: markers and no module-size violations
